Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory39.jpg', 4: '1'}
{1: '25th Floor, High-Rise Construction Site', 2: 'Constellia', 4: '4:05AM'}
{2: '4:05 AM. 25th Floor, High-Rise Construction Site, Constellia.'}
{3: 'Faint moonlight occasionally filters into the dark structure beyond the skeletal concrete pillars. Apart from emergency exit signs, the building offers little illumination.'}
{3: 'Muzzle flash from gunfire could provide light, but revealing your position in a hunt like this is asking for trouble.'}
{2: "But sitting around isn't an option either.", 3: '11'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiHitQiangHuo.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{3: 'Your bullet misses its target, ricocheting and hitting a joint in the scaffolding. The bound steel pipes ring out with a sharp clang.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The Ascendant dodges the shot and makes her entrance. She does not bother to hide her intent to attack, her heels clicking brazenly against the steel grating.'}
{2: 'Eleanor', 3: "I don't think pulling out that gun was the smartest move, Honorable Commandant. Surely you remember the rule that now puts you at a disadvantage?", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Rule 3: The hunter can use a gun if the prey does.', 3: '45', 4: 'ff4e4eff'}
{2: 'Rule 3: The hunter can use a gun if the prey does.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Eleanor', 3: 'Then again, this was always an asymmetrical game. Perhaps I should consider lowering the difficulty a bit for you?', 4: '1'}
{3: "From her upper left comes the hiss of a chain link fence bending under someone's weight."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab'}
{3: 'Eleanor draws her gun and fires at the steel grating where the sound came from. The shot misses, but it is enough to force you to relocate.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'CLANG—'}
{3: 'It turns out that the two shots have severed the bolts holding the scaffolding pipes in place, and a bundle of steel tubes comes clattering down.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Eleanor', 3: 'Hmm, clever trick. Now this is getting interesting.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMovieFilm.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: "This is a deadly game of cat and mouse between the Ascendant and you, with Constellia's safety hanging in the balance."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Eleanor', 3: "Like I said, I'm not a fan of those cliche finales where bombs turn into fireworks. Besides, this won't be the last time we meet here.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'If you can survive Eleanor\'s hunt inside this building from midnight to sunrise on the Double Seventh Festival, she will guarantee Constellia\'s safety "for today."', 2: '2', 5: '1'}
{1: 'There will also be a generous reward, but Eleanor is keeping it a secret, as she is wont to do.', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Rule 1: The prey may use any means necessary, including hiding, running, and fighting back, to avoid being "killed" by Eleanor.', 2: '2', 5: '2'}
{1: 'Rule 2: The playing field is limited to this construction site. All signals will be jammed, and no reinforcement is allowed. This is a two-player game.', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Rule 3: If the prey chooses to fight back, both sides get equal advantages. For example, the hunter can use a gun if the prey does, and vice versa.', 2: '2', 7: '1'}
{2: "Looks like I don't have a choice.", 3: '61'}
{3: 'There is no escape from this game. Eleanor prides herself on realism, so the danger here is very real. But because it is her, you know there is a way out as long as you follow the rules.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Eleanor', 3: "Don't hold it against me. If I want to get a real reaction out of you, I need to push things a little further.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMovieFilm.prefab'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory64.jpg', 4: '1'}
{1: '42nd Floor, High-Rise Construction Site', 2: 'Constellia', 4: '5:32AM'}
{2: '5:32 AM. 42nd Floor, High-Rise Construction Site, Constellia.'}
{3: 'The solid concrete floors gradually give way to steel mesh grating laid over scaffolding pipes. Through the gaps, you can see the ground dozens of stories below.'}
{3: 'Hence, you have to focus more energy on finding safe escape routes. Meanwhile, your pursuer seems to relish the precarious footing.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Eleanor', 3: "If it were me, I'd just tear up the path behind me... You're not showing nearly enough desperation as the prey.", 4: '1'}
{2: '(The pistol is out of ammo...)', 3: '78'}
{2: 'Eleanor', 3: "Maybe what fascinates me about you is the way you stay composed under pressure, even when everything's on the line.", 4: '1'}
{2: '(There has to be a way...)', 3: '82'}
{3: 'You grab on to the horizontal bars on the scaffolding, using the diagonal braces as footholds to climb higher rung by rung, trying to gain some distance.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Eleanor', 3: "Time's almost up. You shouldn't leave yourself so wide open.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Eleanor calmly finds the perfect firing position, draws her pistol, and flicks off the safety with a click.'}
{2: '(Drop your pistol to the ground)', 3: '88'}
{3: 'Seeing you discard your pistol, Eleanor has no choice but to lower her weapon.'}
{2: 'Eleanor', 3: 'Not bad. A gambler who knows how to leverage the rules is worth my full commitment to the game.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Eleanor ejects the magazine, and it slides free from the pistol, clattering onto the scaffolding with a clang. Taking off a glove, she produces a silver switchblade from her waist.'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory78.jpg', 7: '0|0|-100'}
{1: 'Top Floor, High-Rise Construction Site', 2: 'Constellia', 4: '5:49AM'}
{2: '5:49 AM. Top Floor, High-Rise Construction Site, Constellia.'}
{3: 'You survey your surroundings. There is nowhere left to run.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The female Ascendant emerges slowly from the stairwell behind you calmly and elegantly. If not for the switchblade in her hand, one might mistake this for a date on the rooftop.'}
{3: 'The switchblade flicks open with a sharp metallic click. You know you stand no chance against an armed Ascendant in close combat.'}
{2: 'Eleanor', 3: "Honorable Commandant, you've far exceeded my expectations.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Eleanor', 3: 'I want so badly to keep you by my side...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'But this is a matter of principle.', 3: '115', 4: "It's not funny.", 5: '115'}
{2: 'Eleanor', 3: "Well then... I'll save the banter for after the game is over.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiMovie/FxUiMovieDao01.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: 'Eleanor lunges forward, her blade aimed straight for your throat.'}
{3: 'Pressed by the relentless Ascendant, you dodge backward, right to the edge of the rooftop.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiMovie/FxUiMovieDao01.prefab'}
{2: 'Eleanor', 3: "Yes! Just like this! I've kept my distance all night long, all for this moment of closeness.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Eleanor', 3: 'Your expression in the face of death is absolutely exquisite... Your body is burning with adrenaline, yet your face remains so perfectly ruthless.', 4: '1'}
{2: "(There's no way out!)", 3: '136'}
{3: "Forcing you to the rooftop's edge, the entranced Eleanor shows no sign of letting up. Your heels hang over empty air, and there is nothing left to stand on."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineSpreadNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineSpreadNew.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1041.jpg', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory428.jpg', 4: '7'}
{1: '1007', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory428.jpg', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '1'}
{3: 'After dodging another strike aimed at your vitals, you stumble and slip over the edge, barely catching hold of the ledge to avoid the fall.'}
{3: 'The instant your fingertips grip the concrete edge, searing pain shoots through the tendon sheaths in your fingers.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Eleanor', 3: '"If a person never falls in their lifetime, they\'ll only know what falling feels like when they die."', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Eleanor aims her switchblade at the back of your hand—the one desperately gripping the edge.'}
{3: 'The moment the blade touches your skin, you let out a long breath and look east.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiturntable/FxUiturntable01.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'The timely morning light falls across both your faces.'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1041.jpg', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Top Floor, High-Rise Construction Site', 2: 'Constellia', 4: '5:51AM'}
{2: '5:51 AM. Top Floor, High-Rise Construction Site, Constellia.'}
{3: 'Luckily, sunrises come earlier than expected in summer.'}
{1: '1', 3: "As if stirred by the warmth, Eleanor's frenzied, twisted expression settles down."}
{3: 'She lets out a soft laugh, pockets the switchblade, and extends her gloved hand to you.'}
{2: 'Eleanor', 3: 'Grab my hand.', 4: '1'}
{2: "(Grab Eleanor's hand)", 3: '173'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory78.jpg', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiturntable/FxUiturntable01.prefab'}
{2: 'Eleanor', 3: "Not even a moment's hesitation? You trust me that easily?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Because you respect the game.', 3: '178', 4: 'Because I believe in the rules.', 5: '178'}
{2: 'Eleanor', 3: "The sun's up. The hunt is over.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'After pulling you up, Eleanor gives a few light pats to the back of your hand.'}
{2: 'Eleanor', 3: 'Well done. Excellent work.', 4: '1'}
{2: "Your praise doesn't exactly make me happy.", 3: '183'}
{2: 'Eleanor', 3: "How naughty, Honorable Commandant... It seems like you're the one who can't read the room right now.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Eleanor', 3: "For your reward, I'll grant you one request. No strings attached.", 4: '1'}
{2: "Next time, don't use other people's lives as leverage.", 3: '188'}
{2: "That's all I ask.", 3: '189'}
{2: 'Eleanor', 3: 'As you wish.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Eleanor walks to the edge of the rooftop and opens her parasol.'}
{3: 'One step, two steps, three... She begins to stroll along the edge, and not even the fierce winds at this height can disturb her leisurely pace.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Eleanor', 3: 'You know, Honorable Commandant, I can be quite particular about certain things.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Eleanor', 3: "...Especially when someone sets conditions for me. I'd scrutinize every single word, you see?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She suddenly turns and flashes you a radiant smile.'}
{2: 'Eleanor', 3: "I'm thrilled, truly, Honorable Commandant. You have been so generous to me... I'm quite overwhelmed!", 4: '1'}
{3: 'That smile shifts back into her usual mocking grin.'}
{2: 'Eleanor', 3: "That last part of your request... I take it to mean that I'm free to harm you however I please next time. Correct?", 4: '1'}
{3: '还未来得及喊出想说的话，升格者便向后仰身，一跃而下。'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Eleanor', 3: 'Do look forward to it, my Honorable Commandant!', 4: '18'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1041.jpg', 4: '1'}
{3: 'By the time you rush to the edge and peer over, the violet figure has already vanished without a trace.'}
